Food records describe particular foods and editions. Ingredients, preparation and serving size can change the nutrition in a real meal. Use the closest record you can find and enter a portion that reflects what you ate.

    A broad library. Clear estimates.

    159,088 food records. The offline iPhone library includes listed portions for foods where measures are available. The web preview offers one suggested serving per food; enter a weight in grams or choose an available measure in the app.

    Honest nutrition gaps. Values are estimates per 100 g. Missing or unusually high nutrient values are left unavailable, and recipes or preparation can change the result.

    This guide is general food information, not medical or nutrition advice. For nutrition guidance about a medical condition, consult your doctor or a qualified healthcare professional.

    Food data sources include USDA FoodData Central (CC0 1.0) and the CoFID 2021 dataset. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
